_README: DEPRECATED / NOT IN THE TRUST PATH. Cold review bq4z7midf flagged that an agent-writable json registry is forgeable (the agent could self-register its own 'Clay target'). The daemon NO LONGER reads this file. Target statements are now registered via a daemon-signed, hash-chained `target_register` transition (operator-attested: requires close.i_am_operator=true AND env ZTARE_OPERATOR_TARGET=1). To register a target, the OPERATOR submits: propose --type target_register --close '{"statement_sha256":"<hex of canonical Lean statement>","label":"<human label>","i_am_operator":true}' with ZTARE_OPERATOR_TARGET=1. The commit-membrane closure check (R5''') requires the F-row's target_statement_hash to be a member of the CHAIN-VALID signed target_register set. Residual (correctly irreducible): whether a registered statement IS the Clay problem is one-time human mathematical curation. Residual (R2-class, honest): operator-vs-agent gating of target_register is env/flag-attested + ledgered, not cryptographically operator-only (needs keys outside the agent boundary; deploy layer).
